reviews.text: Brought my mini Australian Shepherd Chance in for an eye issue this morning, and I can't say enough good things about this clinic. Madison and Dr. Tittle were both incredibly gentle and patient with Chance — he can be nervous at the vet, but they took their time and made him feel completely at ease. Really grateful for the care they showed him. Highly recommend CityVet Oak Lawn!

I went to City Vet when they first opened their doors in Oak Lawn.  For 27 years, they’ve consistently given my dogs exceptional care- treating them like they were their own.  I can’t imagine going anywhere else.
We love Dr. Anthony!  Plus the convenience of getting our 60lb bulldog fully groomed makes life easier and better!  And….Saturday appointments with our Doc!!!!!

From the moment I called in for an urgent appt for my dog to the actual appt and every single staff member we saw, including the vet- we were taken care of with empathy, patience, kindness and consideration every step along the way. Emergency surgery and post-op care exceeded our expectations and eased our worries after such an exhausting and traumatizing event that occurred last night. I’m so glad we decided against the ER and waited for this location to open instead and that they could receive my pup as early as they possibly could. We’d love to return just to bring the entire staff who took care of Bron today, a token of thanks.  Empathy and customer care are essential in this line of work and we’re so thankful this place gets it- entirely. 10/10 experience here!

Cannot recommend this place more. Dr. Sammi Tittle is wonderful. She takes great care of the animals, is always accommodating and kind, and is always very helpful in explaining costs, options and diagnosis. We have had only good experiences with them. They were very kind and empathetic when our dog passed and have taken great care of our cat.
Great staff, friendly amazing doctors. Highly recommend.

I couldn’t have asked for a better Veterinarian 🐾 to transfer  from my Hometown in San Diego. City Vet has definitely made my Transfer to Dallas a lot more easy knowing that my little man is going to be taken care of very well.

A truly fantastic clinic. Our cat needed a complex and delicate surgery that required an exceptionally skilled team, and we genuinely feel we found the best veterinary team in DFW. They treated our cat with incredible care, kindness, and expertise throughout the entire process. We are eternally grateful for everything they did.

Veronica Mendoza was especially amazing. She was compassionate, attentive, and incredibly reassuring during such a stressful time. Whatever she is getting paid, it is not enough. She is a tremendous asset to this clinic. We could not recommend CityVet Oak Lawn more highly!
Terrible service and care. Proceed with caution.

Love love love Cityvet Oak Lawn!! They have been nothing short of amazing with my pets. I’ve brought in my senior cat and senior dog for a variety of concerns, and I’ve been impressed every time. They are always so kind and informative, both in person and on the phone.

I would highly recommend fr Rachael neese and this practice. We just made the decision to put our sweet scout to sleep. In the 11  years  going to this practice our experience has been the best. Dr neese made the time to be with us to say goodbye to scout and the whole team made this hard thing a little easier.
Upfront pricing and excellent care. Friendly staff get along great, even with a feisty Chihuahua.

City vet is literally highway robbery!!! I’m paying $45 (6.50 per pill) for a weeks worth of my dogs allergy medicine when the retail price is $82 $2.75 per pill) for a months worth. That a 250% markup!!! Recently my dog had kennel cough and not once did they do any testing on her! Had to come back two days later for worsen symptoms. Took her to another vet and was tested and confirmed she had kennel cough $600 later!!! For the amount that I’m paying I can catch a flight to my hometown and get the medication and same services for way cheaper!!! I shouldn’t have to pay an arm and a leg to make sure my baby s straight
Clean, friendly, honest and to the point. No mealy-mouth waste of breath dialog.  I'll be back.

We went there on August 15, 2026 for a medical concern for dog Maggie.  I was quite impressed with the speed and efficiency of having her seen as well as quick results. The price was reasonable when compared with other vet clinics in Dallas.

I brought my puppy in for an emergency visit today because he ate something off the road..  The vet prescribed Royal Canin Gastrointestinal wet food but failed to tell me to stop his regular diet. To make matters worse, the assistant gave incorrect information.Because of this severe communication breakdown, my puppy mistakenly ate 4 meals today. My usually energetic puppy is now completely lethargic and passing smaller stools from overeating. If I had not been cautious enough to research online and call them back to verify, my puppy would have suffered for days.
This clinic is irresponsible and disorganized..

I can’t recall the name of the woman, but the receptionist was rude as it can be. Can’t do customer service asking if I got a new puppy what it would be cost wise for her third set of vaccination shots. She hung up on me.

I lost a pet within the same week and she was clueless as it gets.

Go elsewhere.

All the staff is always so helpful! My cat was unfortunately diagnosed with lymphoma this year and Dr. Anthony and all staff have been extremely helpful throughout this process.. I can’t stress enough how grateful I am to have chosen them as her primary vet!

Dr. NEESE and the entire team at CityVet - Oak Loan are great and provided excellent care for my cat, Lilibet. They were kind, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly. Highly recommend!

Took my dog to the vet yesterday and they didn’t really seem concerned nor interested my dog had stomach issues and instead of them suggesting some kind of inflammatory or some kind of medication. They just gave him a shot which did not work because he still sick and it cost me $200 and for me to turn around to have to Chewy, which had the medication for him it wasn’t half as much. This is sad. Veterinarians are straight robin folks. They really don’t care about the dog. They just want the money which is sad. Why didn’t you even get in this profession if you can’t give good advice and just trying to get the money out of people it’s crazy. I hope you guys are happy .

We needed to take a kitten that we found. The clinic is open late so we were able to get in the same day. The staff is very friendly and kept us informed of all that was going on.  We'll be going back to this clinic for all our pet needs.  Very friendly and good place to take your pet.

The manager in here is trash she’s the worst not helpful Very unkind and unprofessional person. This city vet OakLawn is like Jack in the box. Bottom of the Barrel. Including the Staff. This place is a nightmare.
Wonderful first visit,

We had an amazing experience with Dr. Murphy and City Vet Uptown. I have used City Vet for nearly 3 decades with different pets, but most recently our dog Mochi, who was a rescued stray and had pretty severe dental issues. Dr. Murphy, Dr. Duran, and City Vet gave a thorough examination, loving care, explanation of our options, and amazing execution. They were transparent and open about pricing ( which was reasonable, considering the massive amount of work needed) and even called us twice during the procedure to discuss potential options. Mochi‘s regular vet is Dr. Duran, who is, simply put, amazing, and Dr. Murphy performed the procedure. Aftercare was great and recovery has been a breeze.
So expensive. They make it unaffordable to be a dog parent. Thank goodness for Animal clinics.

My pets are usually patients at the Cedar Hill location, but due to vacation boarding I needed my large breed dog’s (Dolly) annual moved up a few days.  Cedar Hill couldn’t fit us in, so we called Oak Lawn location & they were able to see us the next day!  Dr. Serena Anthony is an amazing doctor and I was very impressed with her thorough examination.  She listened patiently as I explained Dolly’s adventure from abandoned dog in East Texas to Cane Rosso Rescue here in DFW (where I foster failed) and the health complications she faced in her first year of life.  Dr. Anthony also built great rapport with Dolly and didn’t rush into the exam immediately, which I really appreciate.  She answered all questions and provided lots of helpful information! The location in Oak Lawn was convenient, and the staff were very friendly and helpful!

So glad we came here to have them help Tucker get to heaven. They were sooooo accommodating and nice, thoughtful and helped us through this difficult time. I recommend them for anything you might need.

I love this company, everyone is so professional and affable and takes very good care of my baby, Minnie Ava Bennett.

The staff is extremely affable. These people have taken care of my baby for along time. I'm so thankful. As we encounter a next chapter. We're now dealing with old age and diabetes. I'm confident that all will be well.
Far and away the best vet in dfw. Communicates everything clearly and takes the best care of my two big labs!
Excellent place for pet vet services!

Dr. Anthony and her staff were incredibly friendly and thorough. They managed to get me in the same day for my dog. Dr. Anthony was patient with my dog and explained everything to me in a clear and understandable manner. Will for sure go back there in the future.

I brought in Asher after he had been throwing up and not acting like himself. The staff & doctors were amazing!! They laid out multiple different options I had based on his condition/symptoms and helped me pick the best approach. Asher was so comfortable the whole time, he didn’t even flinch when they gave him his shot! Definitely recommend!

Had an amazing experience! The staff (Aliyah specifically) was so kind and detailed in everything we went for! Short wait time and they helped keep our nerves cool. Dr. Thomas was phenomenal in taking care of our urgent need!
Amazing urgent care! They were able to get my dog in ASAP and do emergency surgery on a Sunday. The staff was amazing and so helpful I definitely recommend!

Oak lawn always does an amazing with my German Shepherd. He is very nervous and anxious so when the nurses and doctors make shots and check up as smooth as possible it is so helpful.

Updated 02/20/26: I always come here and called to make an appointment at 9:30 Friday and I get here and they tell me they can’t attend me because I didn’t confirm my appointment. I already called you for the appointment if I needed to cancel I would call you. Wasted time.
Dr. Neese is a terrific vet. She answers all my questions thoroughly and is so sweet and patient with my cat. I highly recommend her!

Absolutely love how kind and helpful the staff are here at CityVet-Oak Lawn! The entire staff is incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful.
Dr. Rachel was great as usual. She took the time to thoroughly address my dog’s needs and made sure we felt comfortable every step of the way. Will return as needed, most definitely recommending to others :)

This is a POS Establishment with a Gross lack of empathy.  After stating that I had moved here and looking for a Primary Vet and that my dog currently needed wound care.  I was “hung up on” by an employee by the name of Stormie. Then after calling back and requesting a manager they simply let me know they did not want/need my business cause they are full as a clinic and no longer taking new patients. So do not waste your time with this “caregiver” they are totally booked and no longer need any more business.

At first blush, I thought service was fine. But then had to take my dog back to vet the next day. Found out city vet charged me for test they had no results for. Asked for $130 refund on my $1000+ bill for test they could not find results for, that my regular vet performed again, and City Vet manager Christine told me to pound sand. They charge you extra 30% for weekend visits, then fail to do what they say, and manager tells you to go away even though you are a repeat customer ( we spent $1500 on another dog requiring weekend attention). Bottom line is customer service (Christine) is terrible.

My experience at CityVet was mixed. The staff was polite, but I left concerned about the level of care and follow-up.

My dog was diagnosed with severe hip dysplasia and was clearly in pain. It has now been a week, and I still have not received confirmation that the promised specialist referral was sent. In a situation like this, timely communication is very important.
Also, I specifically requested a blood test because I was worried about my dog’s health. I was told bloodwork is only recommended for dogs 5 years and older. This was very surprising to me. Blood tests can be useful at any age when there are symptoms or when an owner is concerned. In a stressful situation, especially when a pet’s condition suddenly changes, I would expect the clinic to at least offer the option or explain it more thoroughly instead of dismissing it.

Then, I asked more than once (including previous visits) for a proper ear examination with swabs. The examination felt very brief and appeared to be only a quick visual look from the outside, and I was told everything was fine. However, my dog continues to scratch the same ear, so I do not believe this was a complete ear evaluation. I expected an ear cytology/swab to rule out infection or yeast rather than a quick check.

Additionally, the visit fee alone was $79, not including other treatments and charges. For that cost, I would expect a more thorough diagnostic approach and more attention to ongoing symptoms.

I also want to mention something uncomfortable during visits. Each time my dog urinates or defecates in the clinic, staff immediately point it out. This is a veterinary clinic, not a spa. Animals are stressed and this happens. I have no problem cleaning after my dog if needed, but it should be handled professionally and without making the owner feel awkward. Considering the cost of services, basic cleaning procedures should already be part of clinic operations.

I appreciate the kindness of the staff, but I believe communication, diagnostic thoroughness, and client experience need improvement.

I can not thank Dr. McLaughlin and Nicolette enough for taking such good care of my cat when the ER failed her, they were able to do foreign body Surgery on my girl and send her home same day. Thank you to Dr. Neese as well who made a plan to get her taken care of.

I came back for a refill on a prescription and they made me schedule another exam ($100) then proceeded to prescribe the exact same medication as 2 weeks ago.

So if you are expecting to get refills here, don’t, each one will come with a $100 fee because they will make you do another exam for absolutely no reason.

Took my cat there thinking something was wrong with her labor seeing as 3-4 hours had passed without another kit she ended up having it and the next morning when it was clear something was wrong I called to see what we could do described what was happening with the kitten and told them I'd have to talk with my partner about it as we are broke and moving called them back for more details about an hour later and when my partner called about 30 minutes after that we were told that we needed to stop and go elsewhere for a dying kitten my and my partner weren't thinking straight but given hindsight now that the kitten has died it needed formula so I will not be returning with any of my animals as they turned away a dying kitten they could've helped survive but they chose to be rude and antagonistic instead of helping living thing that was in pain dying

This veterinary clinic is top-notch. Dr. Thomas is a Professional beyond bounds. The technicians are well-versed, courteous, and most important, they care about the health, and welfare of the pups and other pets that they see. This is a gem of the Oak Lawn neighborhood.
They are not my vet and keep sending me emails

I've seen both Dr. McLaughlin and Dr. Tittle for urgent puppy visits and they have been phenomenal in caring for my puppy! The front office staff are kind, helpful, and efficient. If you are looking for a general vet or need an urgent visit I would highly recommend City Vet Oaklawn!
Super job today!!
They forced me to delete my 1 star review and got banned from this vet because we had a bad experience awhile ago but im putting it back up cause im the boss

Wonderful experience! Dr Tittle is kind caring and compassionate. The practice makes everything super convenient, online booking, pharmacy, grooming all you could ask for! Modern and up to date facilities and RESONABLE pricing!! I found my new vet!!! Thanks CityVet for being AWESOME!!!
Very caring and efficient staff

I had an incredible experience here today. From the front desk to the vet tech to the vet, truly top notch. It was a stressful day as a pet owner with an injured pet and they made it bearable. Can’t recommend them enough, and I never leave reviews.
The staff are nice and friendly, but this place is WAYYYYY overpriced. 45 bucks to trim my dogs nails?!?!?!? I've taken my dog here for 3+ years but we won't be going back.

Dr Sammi was the perfect balance of professional, sympathetic, and direct when it came to the diagnosis. I got an extra few months with him because of her. Dr Bridget, and her amazing assistant, made the last visit so very peaceful.

Went there at 5:30 and was refused to be seen because they were abiding by holiday hours (6pm close vs regular 7pm close), not on an actual holiday though. Turned away a sick 5 month puppy even with ample time before closing. Awful

I brought my bunny there today and had a great experience. What could have been an outrageously high bill, ended up being super reasonable and my bunny is responding to the medication ultra fast. I highly recommend this city vet! Plus, the tech was also a bunny owner!
Walkin visit with a short wait.  Friendly and professional staff.
Great experience, very nice fast and affordable. Took great care of my boy Nuka

I took my little Pomeranian in because he was having what I thought was a subluxation of his kneecap and sure enough that's what it was. They did not over diagnose or treat with diagnostics or medication, and they were very prompt and gentle and extremely knowledgeable
The feral cat’s breathing was labored. I bought a shot for the cat to handle secondary infections. Dr Anthony did a great job of explaining the options.
Love the way they take care of my furry friend.

Such a kind and caring veterinarian! She treated my dog with so much patience and love, and made both of us feel completely comfortable. It’s clear that she truly cares about animals and her clients. The service was professional, gentle, and honest. I really appreciate her help and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a great vet! 🐾

My husband and I have taken our dog here since we adopted him a year ago. The staff are very and caring and very speedy. The staff clearly love animals. They are pricey, but they are transparent about pricing. We have never had trouble getting an appointment at a convenient time, even on short notice. We get our dog's vaccines and heartworm testing with another (cheaper) vet, but we continue to use CityVet as our dog's primary vet. For reference, a sick visit was $200 total ($60 exam, $70 lab test, $70 prescription), and an annual visit was $250 total ($120 for exam & fecal test, $130 for optional bloodwork).

Dr. McLaughlin is the best. She is always thoughtful, caring and diligent in her care of my two pups. She operates with empathy but also practicality. Also everyone at this practice is kind and remembers your name/your pets name.

I was told it was normal for my bunny to be low energy because of the medicine and he passed away not long after. They did treat him pretty well when they saw him, I just wish they’d done more. Also vets usually call the next day to check on the pets, they didn’t. I guess I can’t blame them, I’m sure they’re very busy.
They fit my dog in at end of day she was having an allergic reaction. They were very sweet and they took care of us.

I paid to have my dog spayed on 12/02/2019, by Dr. Michael Chafin. My dog has pyometra and is urinating pus. I PROMISE, there will be a lawsuit!
Update.. just received a call from Dr.Neese, telling me to remove my review! No way!  Since you want to “ fish for info”, tell me that the vet is no longer with the company, is not my concern. Dr Neese, I don’t care if this is “ hurting your business “.. what do you think it’s doing to my dog?!?! Why do you keep texting me?

I recently had to say goodbye to my cat of 16 years. This was the first time in my adult life I’ve had to euthanize a pet. I don’t know what I expected, but CityVet handled it with a level of care and dignity that made an otherwise horrible experience easier. I will forever be grateful to the CityVet folks. From the front desk person to the doctor, my pet and I were well taken care of.

My baby girl was seen for an earache. The vet tech and the vet were very helpful. They looked in her ears and did cytology on the was they removed. She did have bacteria. She was treated with an ear gel after her ears were thoroughly cleaned. I don’t have to struggle with ear drops or medication at home. Overall, I’m very pleased.

The staff here are wonderful, kind people. They care deeply about what they do. We’ve been coming for years (we drive all the way from Oak Cliff to work with them) and they’ve always been thoughtful about treatments for our animals.

We unfortunately had to say goodbye to our cat this past week. It was incredibly sad. But this team (Dr. Neese, especially) walked us through all of our options equally and without any judgement. She helped us arrive at the right decision for our pet. You cannot ask for more from your vet, even in the hardest moments.

Thank you, CityVet. We are customers for life.

I’ve taken my dog to City Vet Oak Lawn for both urgent and routine care and highly recommend them! The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, and they’re especially attentive given my dog is nervous around new people.

We had to put our dog down, and they lost her blanket that we left with them! they kept lying about it and saying the cremation company picked it up when I’m for sure they didn’t. They are reckless with animal belongings. I ZERO OUT OF 10 RECOMMEND!!!!!! Don’t take your pets here! Amanda the manager didn’t help she literally was just saying it got picked up as well and then proceeded to say “we will keep an eye out for it”… how if it got picked up by the cremation company like you said?!?! They are lying because they lost my belongings! Lastly Amanda said the technicians name was Windy and she didn’t feel comfortable giving last names even though as health care professionals you should always be willing to provide last names.
DO NOT BRING YOUR PETS HERE TO PUT THEM DOWN BECAUSE THEY ARE RECKLESS AND DONT CARE ABOUT ANIMALS!!!!

Cairo just had his annual physical and got a clean bill of health! Vaccinations are up to date, and those twice-a-day walks are clearly working…he’s holding steady at a healthy 17 pounds. We feel so lucky to have Dr. Neese caring for both Cairo and our cat Jodi. They absolutely love her, and she’s an amazing veterinarian whose diagnostic skills and empathy made such a difference, especially when my Nina was sick. Dr. Neese truly understands that sometimes she’s helping the pet parent just as much as the pet.

The entire staff at City Vet Oaklawn is the absolute BEST. Walking in always feels like that old TV show…sometimes you want to go where everybody knows your name. Warm, welcoming, and caring every single time. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of our furry family!

#CityVetOakLawn
#BestVeterinarianDFW

We first saw Dr. Neese in 2020, not long after the lockdown. And even though we didn't get to interact face-to-face (phone only), I could feel how much she cared, taking extra time to answer any and all questions I had. The staff is wonderful as well, from the front desk and customer service to the tech and beyond, I have had nothing but positive experiences with them. We moved to another neighborhood in 2022, and for the sake of convenience, we started going to a vet that is across the street. It was a good experience, but not like Dr. Neese. When my 14 year old pup got a lump on his stomach, I knew I had to go see Dr. Neese because of the depth of trust she built with us. (luckily, the lump is nothing to be concerned about) TBH, when I first went to CityVet, I was hesitant because it is a chain brand, but a neighbor referred me, and they were right. TL;DR - Highly recommend... I will forever choose trust over convenience and continue to go to Dr. Neese and CityVet Oaklawn, even if it is a little bit out of the way.

I think it was a good experience, because although it took me about 3 hours to get out of the appointment, they resolved my dog's medical problem, and that's the most important thing. He's now in very good health; it was worth the wait.

This place is fantastic! Very kind staff who truly cares. Had to take our golden in for a hot spot that was about to get infected. We are from out of town so needed an urgent care. They saw us immediately and we were out in 45 minutes. Quick and well priced. Lucky we found such a great spot in a pinch!

Do not ever take your dog here! They all misdiagnosed my dog repeatedly. Ruined his health, lied to his insurance about him having a prior condition and damn well nearly killed my Ace! Not once not twice! I haven't sued you for negligence and attempted murder because I just really never want nothing to do with this facility!  But I repeat they are a screw up sorry excuse of an establishment who should be ashamed of themselves. Half-baked crooks. Avoid Dr Rachel Neese, that was the doctor that first misdiagnosed Ace and lied on Doctor’s note about Ace’s condition. Then a Dr Amy Shelden stepped in and promised to fix the errors, she ordered a 1000 tests and X-rays we had to pay thousands for and still couldn’t help him till we changed our provider to a private pet hospital. A bunch of clueless doctors. It’s was all a nightmare I wouldn’t wish on my worse enemy.
got my bunny neutered here for only like 200 something with a 100 dollar down payment no complications very nice staff and probably the cheapest to get your bunny fixed in dallas-fort worth😝 …

The doctors as well as the staff are all amazing. It doesn't matter if you have a cat or a dog. It's awesome when you have a professional that loves what they do. Amber, Mimi and the Murphy family love you right back.

When I asked how much the chest x-ray costed , I thought she said $42. When I went to go pay for it, it was $442. Im left wondering if she intentionally mumbled so all I heard was $42. Anyways, I paid over $500 for this visit. Had I known it was $442 chest x-ray I would’ve skipped that. It’s ok, I just won’t be returning.

The doctors and the nurses were very helpful and they were very kind they helped sugar get better she had a really bad cut they took good care of her I would recommend this facility to anyone for their pet
Professional  customer service with soft heart for your fur babies.  Although busy they were able to work.us in at Oaklawn City Vet. Thanks from Peppy and I.

My 6 month old puppy hurt his leg, they were able to get me in the same day despite being fully booked because the receptionists saw he was in pain and did what they could to help. Dr. Murray was amazing as well. I appreciated the time and attention he gave to the issue as I was very worried about my puppy!

Here’s a draft for your review based on your experience:

Disappointed with the Service

I recently called City Vet at Oak Lawn to schedule an appointment for my dog. As a non-native English speaker, I found the receptionist’s response too fast and unclear. She didn’t confirm the appointment properly, and during our conversation, she hung up the phone without saying goodbye or ensuring everything was clear.

As a result, I showed up today at 12:30, believing that was my appointment time, only to be told my appointment was actually at 3:30. This lack of communication meant I had to come to the clinic twice in one day, which was very frustrating and inconvenient.

I expected better professionalism and clear communication, especially when it comes to something as important as scheduling appointments. I’m quite unhappy with the service I received and hope the clinic improves in this area to prevent similar issues for others.

I can't say enough wonderful things about CityVet Oak Lawn and especially Dr. Sammi Tittle. She goes above and beyond in caring for both pets and their owners. Her combination of expertise, patience, and genuine compassion sets her apart.

Dr. Tittle is not only incredibly knowledgeable, but she also takes the time to truly listen to concerns, offering thoughtful guidance and reassurance. She has a warm, kind, and comforting presence that makes every visit a positive experience. It’s clear that she loves what she does, and her passion for animals shines through in every interaction.

If you’re looking for a vet who will treat your pets like her own, Dr. Tittle and the team at CityVet Oak Lawn are simply the best!

Great customer service when me and my grandfather walked in they immediately acknowledged us with a smile and rubbed my golden doodle named Dior she was so happy and the staff loved her I already feel like this place is home for my dog I’m sad my dog has fleas and they gave me great recommendations and follow up appointments which I loved so they can treat and care for her needs and I love that they have a groom place across the street and it meant so much that they called and told me she did a great job I told them she thought she was at the beauty shop 🤣🤣🤣 🐶 ❤️

They were able to get us in as a walk in very quickly and then scheduled our dog for a surgery the very next day to remove a cancerous tumor. Pricing was up front and they were able to communicate very clearly regarding follow up and our dogs status.

Been going here for years out of convenience and have always felt something is off about this place. The ethics and prices are weird. They charge you during your visit (which is normal) then on your next visit they say you owe money from your last visit. You’re always questioning what’s going on. Nail trims are either $15, $20, today $35. It’s not consistent and feels made up.
Charlie loves seeing Dr Sammy at CityVet.  She always remembers him and that alone makes me feel good about the quality of care he receives.   Highly recommend.
Dr. McLaughlin always does a wonderful job with Aurora! She has had pleasant visits since switching to her! Front office are sweet thorough and understanding! Thank you City Vet!

Took my dog over for a walk in visit. Was quickly seen. Dr Rutherford listened attentively. Vet tech asked appropriate questions and was reassuring. Will requests both on her return visits. City vet has cared for my dogs over the 13 or so years I have lived in Dallas.

Dr. McLaughlin and the staff at city vet are wonderful. We took our dog to them for emergency care and they stayed after hours to help her. They were all incredibly kind and gave our sweet girl amazing care.

Just moved to Texas and needed to bring my dog in for a mass/limp on a Sunday.  Cityvet urgent care offers great hours and reasonable prices. Dr Neese was great and explained course of treatment thoroughly. I would recommend

Everyone here is so fantastic. My dog had an infection on her tail and ended up having to get about 3/4 of an amputated due to necrosis. The staff, especially Dr McLaughlin and Dr. Shelden, who were the two people professional, and above all, caring! They helped calm me down, told me my options were, worked with me when there was an issue regarding payment, were very clear in the aftercare instructions, and made sure that Coco was calm and as comfortable as she could be during the whole scenario. 10/10 I don't want to ever have to go to the vet with my dog again, but if I do, I'm definitely going here first!
My cat 🐈‍⬛ was happy to see the staff and vet technician. I highly recommend here. …

Came in today for an exam on dog and to be honest I am Truly disappointed if I’m paying almost $400 To have my dog taken care of the exam could be a lot better and more thorough. Last year I went to the other location on McKinney Avenue and the doctor was fantastic. He really took his time to actually look at My dog And make sure that he was healthy and had everything that he needed and even educated me on some things to be aware and Be a better dog owner. This exam was so quick all she did was do his shots and that’s it… Also, I feel like if I’m paying this much they could trim his nails complementary and not ask for $35 to trim That’s about half the cost of a full service groom, which is ridiculously expensive, especially whenever Almost $400 to have them look at my dog and they don’t even care… The only reason why I made my appointment at the Oaklawn location was because I called on a Saturday and I really Needed some flea prevention medication refilled, and they informed me that he needed an exam before doing so so I just made the next available But I will never be going to this location ever again because of the lack of care. Truly disappointed.

Very thorough and kind staff from front desk, to techs, and doctors. They were very good at explaining different treatment options available to help keep costs manageable.  Very good at handling my very nervous elderly pup.
Friendly staff. Vet explains everything well. My dog leaves happy 😁 …

My dog needed a specific prescription dog food on a Sunday but our usual vet was closed. Everyone here at City Vet Oak Lawn / urgent care was so amazing. I did not have a prescription, but Dr. Rachel Neese saw Charlie this afternoon for a complementary exam and we were able to get his food! I was so happy with everything from start to finish. Kayla at the front desk was also very kind, professional and helpful. Thank you! Highly recommend. They genuinely care.
